design.mechanism: A figure-associated whole is a process-state/material reference whose interpretation is selected by apparatus stage or material flow.
design.prediction: Held figure labels should track repeated material/process states or apparatus stages more consistently than person identity, patient identity, or literal bathing role.

circulation, separation, and staged-transformation system**.  Their human
